detail: notFoldedThisSuccessor[2] reads: 'Claude v3 REJECT (SARIFV3-*) was folded at v4 as the claimed v3 repair; this successor folds only the frozen Codex v4 remainder.' That sentence attaches the wrong reviewer's identifier namespace to the wrong verdict. It uses no SARIFV3-* identifier anywhere.

SARIFV3-B1 and SARIFV3-S1 are the Codex v3 identifiers. That review is at 5fe5847e…, mode 0644, with verdict 'PENDING' and reviewState 'IN-PROGRESS'. It is neither frozen nor a REJECT. The sentence therefore describes a frozen REJECT that does not carry those IDs, using IDs that belong to an unfrozen PENDING review — and Codex's own frozen v4 verdict is explicit on this point, recording provisionalPriorFindings as IN-FLIGHT-NOT-FROZEN with digestClaimed false.

The closure claim is also not true as stated. Of my three v3 findings, CLAUDE-V3-B1 and CLAUDE-V3-B2 are genuinely discharged — B1 by v4's tagged not-produced variant and v5's completed union, B2 by v5's nativeMappings rewrite, both verified below. CLAUDE-V3-S1 is not. It asked that folded verdicts be pinned so every referenced finding identifier has frozen bytes behind it. v5 pins only codexv4 at ebc9e40c…, and in doing so deletes the codexv2 pin at 579e8685… that v4 carried. The artifact now runs four honestyRepairs sections referencing SARIFV1-*, SARIFV2-*, SARIFV3-* and SARIFV4-* while pinning exactly one of those four verdicts.

The same list is internally inconsistent about advisories. notFoldedThisSuccessor[1] carefully records 'Claude v2 advisories ADV-SPC-V2-01/02/03 remain not folded.' My four v3 advisories are neither folded nor listed. Two of them are still live against v5's own bytes: ADV-SPC-V3-01 (goldenShape.discipline asserts 'There is no projectionSchemaId / projectionSchemaVersion key' while machineSurface declares both) and ADV-SPC-V3-04 (the truncation block still mixes a sibling required array with a per-property required:false). summary: REJECT at 0 blockers and 1 SHOULD-FIX. Both frozen Codex v4 findings are genuinely repaired and I verified each against parsed bytes rather than repair notes. SARIFV4-B1 is closed on both halves: the 'and'-joined native member is deleted outright and replaced by distinct primaryLocationUri and relatedLocationUri per-entry paths, a one-URI-one-role placement rule that explicitly denies the join, and per-entry NFC; and goldenShape.input is now a real tagged union with discriminator variant, no untagged sibling and no structural hostCanonicalResult requirement, with both shipped preview goldens hand-validated against inputNotProduced at zero errors and zero 64-hex tokens. SARIFV4-S1 is closed: OBL-4 answeredAt and requiredOutputFailure.notARendererRefusal both name FC-NONAUTH-TERM and FC-NONAUTH-COVERAGE, no fixture carries the bare ID, and a negative-lookahead sweep of the whole document finds its seven residual mentions confined to historical repair records and append-only reviewer guidance. The v4-to-v5 leaf diff puts zero of 55 changed, added or removed paths outside the eleven-entry roster, both architecture pins reproduce live, line 304 is byte-identical and unique, the 26 carried file-01 lines match exactly, the COORD pin is an exact 218672-byte prefix of a file now 9878 bytes longer, and no recipe, D9 code, preview advertisement, G17 resurrection or positive DR-122 authority appears anywhere. What fails is the fold ledger: notFoldedThisSuccessor records 'Claude v3 REJECT (SARIFV3-*) was folded at v4', but SARIFV3-* are the identifiers of the Codex v3 review, which is mode 0644 with verdict PENDING and reviewState IN-PROGRESS, while the frozen Claude v3 REJECT at 506237dd… mode 0444 carries CLAUDE-V3-B1/B2/S1 and four ADV-SPC-V3-* advisories. Its CLAUDE-V3-S1 is not folded, and v5 re-commits precisely that defect by deleting the codexv2 pin v4 carried, leaving four honestyRepairs sections that reference four verdicts with one of them pinned.
